text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Finally, it's the day of the Unity Cup<n>finals! We
head toward our last<n>challenge as one.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wowzers! We did it! We made it<n>through to the final
match!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I c-can't believe it! That means we're<n>up against
Team Zenith! That's a big<n>yikes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We work our way up through the<n>tournament until
all that remains is to<n>face Team Zenith in the grand
final!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've already filled my team in on<n>everything that's
been going on with<n>Team Zenith lately.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With all our preparations complete,<n>we head off to
the final match, but on<n>the way there, a loud voice
from the<n>grounds catches our attention.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
1,000 meters in 63.9 seconds! You're<n>going too
slow! You're the one who<n>said you were gonna
destroy your<n>target time, so run like you mean it!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I wonder if she's trying to beat<n>the target time
she talked about<n>before?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
No way! How could she have<n>improved so much in
so little time?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Little Cocon's face is flushed with<n>exertion as she
tries to lower her time<n>with all her might.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wow... Look at her go!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Y-you've got this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We all fall silent as we watch her<n>sprint furiously
down the track.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
1,000 meters left! You've just<n>passed 2 minutes
3.5 seconds!<n>You're on track for a new record,<n>Little
Cocon! Come on!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Little Cocon flies down the track with<n>incredible
speed. She turns the fourth<n>corner...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: ...And blasts past the finish line!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Judging from the triumphant cheers<n>that erupt, I can
only assume she's<n>beaten her target time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My team is struck speechless for a<n>moment by the
display.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Holy moly!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
She really managed to smash her<n>record! And all
for Ms. Kashimoto!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: T-Team Zenith is incredible!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Upon hearing Rice Shower's<n>comment, Taiki Shuttle
clenches her<n>fists tightly.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I've... I've made up my mind!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
We're winning the Unity Cup! I<n>absolutely don't
wanna lose today!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Team Zenith is mega incredible... But<n>that's exactly
why it'll be worth<n>beatin' 'em!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I wanna face 'em head-on and<n>defeat 'em with all
our combined<n>strength!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The whole team's faces light up at<n>Taiki Shuttle's
bold declaration.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Yes, I can sense it! I feel a<n>joyful power
blossoming between us<n>and Team Zenith!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Let's reward our most wonderful<n>rivals with our
best performance yet!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I just know that happiness is waiting<n>for us at the
end of all this!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, races are super fun when you<n>get to run in
them with the friends<n>you've been training hard
with!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Let's have fun and win! First place is<n>ours! Woo!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-I want to win too!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Seeing how amazing they are really<n>ignites
something in me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A scarce few hours after this rousing<n>call to victory,
the final match of the<n>Unity Cup begins!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Y'all ready? Happy Hoppers...

text_block_list.name: Team Members
text_block_list.text: Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Okay, that's enough warming up!<n>Time to get a
move on!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Y'all ready? Sunny Runners...

text_block_list.name: Team Members
text_block_list.text: Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Okay, that's enough warming up!<n>Time to get a
move on!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Y'all ready? Carrot Pudding...

text_block_list.name: Team Members
text_block_list.text: Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Okay, that's enough warming up!<n>Time to get a
move on!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Y'all ready? Blue Bloom...

text_block_list.name: Team Members
text_block_list.text: Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Okay, that's enough warming up!<n>Time to get a
move on!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Y'all ready? Team Carrot...

text_block_list.name: Team Members
text_block_list.text: Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Okay, that's enough warming up!<n>Time to get a
move on!

text_block_list.name: Team Members
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
The other team looks pretty fired up.<n>They haven't
been slacking either.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Yeah, they look loads better thanbefore! Loads better... but we cantake them!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
'Cause we're getting better by the<n>second too.
We're determined and<n>focused, and we've been
practicing<n>harder than ever!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
We have to win this. We'll win... and<n>finally bring
this farce to an end!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I watch over the teams from the<n>stands, I spot a
familiar face nearby.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...Here's to a good race today.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Though I'm not sure if I'm in any<n>position to greet
you right now...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: So you're aware.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I was only so strict because I wanted<n>to protect
them... I didn't mean to<n>demoralize them.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: I really am an awful trainer...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I know how much Team Zenith looks<n>up to and
admires Ms. Kashimoto.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Why else would they work so hard to<n>beat their
target times?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I tell Ms. Kashimoto what I saw this<n>morning.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Little Cocon surpassed her target<n>time?!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
That's impossible... How could she<n>have done that
in such a short<n>period?
choice_data_list:
They're giving it everything they've got for your
sake.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I saw how they reacted when<n>Director Akikawa
told us about Ms.<n>Kashimoto's past, and I saw the
fire<n>in their eyes this morning.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It couldn't be clearer how highly<n>Team Zenith
regards Ms. Kashimoto.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It may be safe to say that they see<n>her as the best
trainer in the world.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: You say that, but...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I can't trust myself anymore. I<n>learned nothing from
my past, and<n>now my mistakes are playing out all
over again...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it would be best if I cut my<n>ties with
Umamusume and the racing<n>world...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Kashimoto looks down with a<n>weary sigh. I
notice there are bags<n>under her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After hearing about her past, I thought<n>it would be
impossible to change Ms.<n>Kashimoto's values.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Perhaps I can help in my own way.
choice_data_list: It's too early to lose faith in yourself yet.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: What are you saying?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although micromanaging<n>Umamusume may keep
them safe, it<n>can also stunt their potential.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the flip side, leaving them wholly to<n>their own
devices can lead to terrible<n>accidents with
irreversible<n>consequences.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's why it's best to be watchful<n>but not
overbearing. You should let<n>them be free but
always be ready to<n>intervene if they're in danger.
choice_data_list: That's what being a trainer is to me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Kashimoto looks out on the track<n>with a
conflicted expression on her<n>face.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I still don't know if<n>what you say is
really the right way<n>to do things...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...Let me judge for myself from how<n>these races
unfold.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I follow Ms. Kashimoto's gaze to<n>where the
members of Team Zenith<n>are diligently doing their
warm-ups.
